notes.title: Kowloon High-School Chronicle Available Now!
notes.content:
Ready to start your adventure, Treasure Hunter?!

[b]Kowloon High-School Chronicle[/b] is available on Steam for the first time!
Revisit this classic game with new features for the modern age.
This version contains updated visuals, remastered audio and newly added difficulty levels!

     [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43149038/07eed083ea87a63b08bdda3249a81fc06cd27b89.jpg[/img]        [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43149038/5f3a57ee0683a168b011f1939521478e1f8ca3f5.jpg[/img]

What mysteries await you in the ruins beneath your school?
Dive into this first-person adventure RPG by exploring dungeons, making friends and solving puzzles!
But beware the various forces that want to stand in your way...

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1053390/Kowloon_HighSchool_Chronicle/
